items.title: 13.3 The bond strength of halogen molecules (halogen molecules ke bond ki taqat) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 13.3 with Table 13.3, printed page 294.

blocks.text: Group mein chlorine se iodine tak neeche jate hue halogens ki bond strength (bond ki taqat) kam hoti jati hai. Wajah yeh hai ke neeche jate hue atoms ka size barhta hai, is liye bond lamba (longer bond length) aur weak (kamzor) hota hai. Group 17 mein oopar se neeche bond energy chlorine se iodine tak aahista aahista kam hoti hai. Lekin fluorine is group mein exception (qaide se hat kar) hai. Fluorine ka bond relatively (muqable mein) weak hai kyun ke fluorine ke atoms bohat chhote hain. Chhote size ki wajah se dono fluorine atoms ke lone pairs (bond mein shamil na hone wale electron jore) ek doosre ke bohat qareeb hote hain aur zor se repel (door dhakelna) karte hain. Yeh repulsion bond ko weak kar deta hai, halan ke fluorine ki electronegativity bohat zyada hai. Halogens ki bond energies Table 13.3 mein hain.

blocks.alt: Moti lakeer wala F–F. Har F ke teen narangi lone-pair lobes hain, har ek mein do sabz nuqte: ek oopar, ek neeche aur ek bahar ki taraf. Dono oopar wale lobes aur dono neeche wale lobes ke darmiyan surkh dohre teer; oopar 'lp - lp repulsion' likha hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 13.1: Lone pairs ke saath F2 molecule (kitab ke page 294 ki Figure 13.1 ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing; kitab yeh number do dafa istemal karti hai).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Fluorine ke atoms bohat chhote hain, is liye F–F bond chhota hai aur dono atoms ke lone pairs ek doosre ke bohat qareeb aa jate hain. Teer (lp–lp repulsion) dikhate hain ke yeh jore ek doosre ko dhakelte hain; yahi dhakka bond ko weak karta hai, is liye F₂ ki bond energy (156 kJ mol⁻¹) Cl₂ (243 kJ mol⁻¹) se kam hai.

blocks.prompt: Kaun sa halogen molecule sab se strong bond rakhta hai, aur F₂ ka bond Cl₂ se weak kyun hai?
blocks.explanation: Cl₂ (243 kJ mol⁻¹). F₂ (156 kJ mol⁻¹) mein atoms bohat chhote hain, is liye dono taraf ke lone pairs bohat qareeb aa kar ek doosre ko zor se dhakelte hain aur bond weak ho jata hai. Chlorine ke atoms bare hain, lone pairs door rehte hain, is liye repulsion kam hai.

items: Bond energy Cl₂ (243) > Br₂ (193) > I₂ (151 kJ mol⁻¹): atoms bare, bond lamba aur weak.
F₂ (156) exception hai: chhote atoms ke lone pairs ka repulsion bond ko weak karta hai.
